current_experiment.purpose: Compare joint 1 ps paths and composed 0.1 ps transitions with the same spatial backbone and three training seeds.
current_experiment.checkpoint_selection: Development parents only; score is a ranking heuristic, not a physical acceptance threshold.
current_experiment.temperature_scope: Sampler hardcodes this temperature. It matches this frozen experiment but does not establish configurable temperature conditioning or temperature transfer.
current_experiment.reference_scope: Previously inspected test parents are diagnostic data, not a fresh final holdout.
current_experiment.initial_distribution_scope: Evaluation begins at reference initial states; it does not validate the learned initial-state generator.
current_experiment.increment_interpretation: Later-time branch means are conditional on the common initial parent, not on a shared instantaneous state. They must not be described as a direct local drift estimator at later times.
current_experiment.phase_interpretation: For the 0.1 ps model every transition is a composition boundary; grouping by ten frames is a diagnostic clock, not a distinction between within-block and seam transitions.
current_experiment.compute_scope: Equal optimizer updates do not imply equal wall time or equal numbers of future spin targets. Generation timing has no matched reference timing in this experiment.

remaining_evidence: Finish all three seeds of both variants and evaluate before concluding that temporal factorization helps.
Freeze the selected method using development evidence before a new independent final holdout.
Validate initial-state distributions separately, or explicitly restrict the claim to a prescribed initial preparation.
Quantify uncertainty at the independent preparation/parent level; spins and frames are not independent experimental replicates.
Validate event definitions and account for censored trajectories; a negative endpoint alone is not a completed reversal.
Check target-size and 10 ns path statistics against independent, numerically validated LLG references.
Benchmark model and LLG generation under stated hardware, batch, output cadence and accuracy requirements.
Do not claim temperature generalization, long-time validity or publication-level reproduction from current short-time diagnostics.
